python3 -B - <<'PY'
import http.client,json,pathlib,subprocess,sys
sha="28d77228df71a3e24ab58e4d912d2cc7b9544cbe"
def check(name,ok):
 print(name+"="+("PASS" if ok else "FAIL"),flush=True)
 if not ok:sys.exit(42)
token=(pathlib.Path.home()/".config"/"tgtumbler"/"tumblr-operation-app"/"tumblr-app-access-token").read_text().strip()
def get(path):
 conn=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",8081,timeout=8)
 try:
  conn.request("GET",path,headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+token})
  r=conn.getresponse()
  return r.status,r.read(180000)
 finally:conn.close()
actual=subprocess.run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=8).stdout.strip()
check("SOURCE_SHA",actual==sha)
status,body=get("/healthz")
check("LIVE_RUNTIME_SHA",status==200 and json.loads(body).get("commit")==sha)
for target in ("/library","/media/jobs","/discovery/candidates"):
 status,body=get(target)
 check("OWNER_API_"+target,status==200 and isinstance(json.loads(body),dict))
for suite in ("test_media_fallback.py","test_library.py","test_media_save.py","test_tumblr_read.py"):
 result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-B","-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests","-p",suite,"-q"],
    stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,timeout=45)
 check("OFFLINE_"+suite,result.returncode==0)
print("ACTUAL_TUMBLR_PROVIDER_CALLS=ZERO")
print("ACCEPTANCE=PASS")
PY
